statement: A Texas filing entity changes its registered agent or registered office by filing Form 401 (Statement of Change of Registered Office/Agent) with the Secretary of State, with a $15 filing fee ($5 for nonprofit corporations and cooperative associations), and the named agent must have consented to the appointment; filing a consent of registered agent for the record costs a further $15 ($5 nonprofit).
caveat: The statutory basis (Business Organizations Code §§ 5.202, 4.152) sits on a statute host that serves a JS-only shell to non-browser clients, so this rule rests on the agency form instructions and FAQ. The SOSDirect/SOSPortal filing hosts ban AI agents by name in robots.txt, so filings are human-driven. This repo does not file the change.
reviewer: Lane editorial review (state process variants wave 2026-10-22); independent domain expert review pending
